basic_details.short_information: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bhubaneswar (AIIMS Bhubaneswar) Guest Faculty Notification 2026 has been released on 25 July 2026 on the official website of AIIMS Bhubaneswar. A total of 6 vacancies have been announced through the AIIMS Bhubaneswar Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026.

Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Guest Faculty posts at AIIMS Bhubaneswar?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Guest Faculty posts at AIIMS Bhubaneswar is 03 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Guest Faculty positions is 64 years, as of 01 September 2026. There is no minimum age specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q3. How will candidates be selected for the Guest Faculty roles?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Faculty positions at AIIMS Bhubaneswar involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates must perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this Guest Faculty recruitment at AIIMS Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree in the respective discipline from a recognized university or institute, along with a minimum of 3 years of experience. A Ph.D. in the respective discipline is desirable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary structure for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: Guest Faculty members will be paid Rs 1000/- per class per hour, with a maximum number of hours varying for each post, ranging from 30 to 115 hours.

faq.question: Q7. Which posts are available for Guest Faculty recruitment at AIIMS Bhubaneswar?
faq.answer: The available posts for Guest Faculty are Biostatistics, Psychology, Sociology, English, Computer, and Regional Language (Odia).

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for these positions?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Guest Faculty positions at AIIMS Bhubaneswar is via email. Candidates need to send their applications to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Guest Faculty positions at AIIMS Bhubaneswar is scheduled to be held on 12 August 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where is AIIMS Bhubaneswar located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Bhubaneswar is located in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, with the pincode 751019.
